`AUDIT.md` is written and verified — all four findings pass the check, and the service tree is untouched (I only ran `node verify.js`, no edits to `src/`, `config/`, or `package.json`).

Findings, most to least severe:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — internal metrics/cache-flush routes have no auth at all (VPN retired, follow-up fix never landed). Critical, live today.
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — `runSavedReport()` splices `filter`/`orderBy`/`direction` straight into SQL, unlike the parameterized `summaryFor()` next to it. Critical primitive, currently latent (no caller yet).
3. **`config/staging.js`** — plaintext staging DB password committed, unlike dev/prod which use env vars. High.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` still pinned at the yanked `1.4.2` (prototype pollution); fix is `1.4.3`. Medium.
